name: Earring of the Other
text: While this piece is equipped, {{SANAUT-001}} no longer reduces your maximum {{energie}}: it is 8 plus the sum of your {{esprit}}, your {{energie}} Levels and every other source of maximum {{energie}}, as for any other character.
description: A point of blue crystal beneath a small sapphire lozenge, hung from a gold hook. Faebie jewellers never cut one alone, and entrust it only to a Scothan.
